title: ImportPlan
description: Frontend import wizard mapping configuration. This is the format the wizard builds interactively before submitting to core's import endpoints. Diagrams the column-to-field mapping for a single import session.
$comment: Matches the ImportPlan interface from the lamina TypeScript codebase ($lib/types/import.ts). Used in the frontend wizard and sent to core as mapping_config.

nameColumn.description: Feature property key used as the entity display name. When null, falls back to source_id or auto-generated label.

namePrefix.description: Optional prefix prepended to the resolved name (e.g. 'Site: ' → 'Site: Tell Brak').

geometryColumn.description: Feature property key containing WKT or GeoJSON geometry. When null, geometry is taken from the Feature's geometry member (GeoJSON-native).

excludedColumns.description: Property keys to exclude from the entity properties block.

visibility.description: Entity visibility assignment per imported record.

mode.description: How classifications are assigned: 'none' — skip; 'fixed' — same term for all rows; 'column' — read from a column.

value.description: Fixed classification term when mode is 'fixed'.

column.description: Property key containing classification terms when mode is 'column'.

delimiter.description: Delimiter for splitting multi-value classification columns.

vocabularyId.description: UUID of the vocabulary to match terms against.

termMapping.description: Map from raw column values to resolved vocabulary term IDs.

mode.description: 'none' — skip dates; 'columns' — extract from mapped columns.

dateFromColumn.description: Property key for the start date.

dateToColumn.description: Property key for the end date.

dateTypeMode.description: How the date type is determined.

dateTypeValue.description: Fixed date type when dateTypeMode is 'fixed'.

dateTypeColumn.description: Property key for the date type when dateTypeMode is 'column'.

dateKeyMode.description: How the date key is assigned (allows multiple date entries per entity).

dateKeyValue.description: Fixed date key when dateKeyMode is 'fixed'.

dateKeyColumn.description: Property key for the date key when dateKeyMode is 'column'.

mode.description: 'fixed' — single entity type for all rows; 'column' — per-row from a property key.

value.description: Fixed entity type when mode is 'fixed'. Defaults to 'place'.

column.description: Property key containing the entity type when mode is 'column'.

relations.description: Relation extraction configuration. Links imported entities to each other or to existing entities via governed predicates.

mode.description: 'none' — skip relations; 'columns' — extract from mapped columns.

targetLabelColumn.description: Column containing label(s) of related entities. Supports multiple targets via delimiter.

delimiter.description: Separator for multiple target labels in a single cell.

direction.description: Role assignment: 'source_is_a' → entity_a=current, entity_b=target; 'source_is_b' → entity_a=target, entity_b=current.

relationTypeMode.description: How the relation predicate is determined.

relationTypeValue.description: Fixed relation predicate when relationTypeMode is 'fixed' (e.g. 'above', 'below', 'cuts').

relationTypeColumn.description: Property key containing the relation predicate when relationTypeMode is 'column'.

termMapping.description: Map from raw column values to resolved entity UUIDs.
